needs.proposedSignature: `Amount { count: 'mv-of-spells-cast-this-turn'; who?: ScopeWho; other?: boolean; filter?: Filter }` — the sum of the mana values of the spells cast this turn, `other: true` excluding the source spell itself
needs.semantics: "equal to the total mana value of other spells you've cast this turn" is a SUM over the mana values of this turn's spells. `Amount.count` has `spells-cast-this-turn`, which is a count of spells, and `mv-of-that`, which is one object's mana value; nothing sums a set. The engine already keeps `spellsCastThisTurn` per player, so the store would have to grow into a list of mana values (or a running total) for the turn.
needs.clause: ~ deals damage to each creature your opponents control equal to the total mana value of other spells you've cast this turn.

needs.proposedSignature: widen the face declaration to `cascade?: boolean | number` (n instances) and add `COVER_LINE_RE.cascade = [/^cascade$/i, /^(?:cascade, )+cascade$/i]` with the value check `count(printed 'cascade' words) === (cascade === true ? 1 : cascade)`; game.ts:647 pushes the pending cascade trigger `n` times
needs.semantics: "Cascade, cascade" and "Cascade, cascade, cascade, cascade" are n separate instances of the keyword, each of which triggers separately when the spell is cast (CR 702.85b). `cascade` is a boolean today, so a card with more than one instance cannot be declared and its line cannot be covered. Scripting it as a self `{on:'cast'}` triggered ability is not an alternative: `queueTriggers` scans battlefield permanents only, so a spell's own cast trigger never fires, and on a permanent an unfiltered cast trigger would cascade on every spell its controller casts.
